clips.title: The story
paras: At Lake Al'Ameth, Return to Denalan carries Rellian's alarming news to the botanist studying corruption in Teldrassil. After examining the mossy tumors on timberlings, you head south to help Denalan with his discovery.

Rellian Greenspyre studies the mossy tumors afflicting Teldrassil's timberlings when urgent word arrives from his colleague Denalan. At his camp beside Lake Al'Ameth, Denalan has finally isolated the cause of these unnatural growths on the forest's nature spirits. Rellian recognizes the gravity of this discovery and sends you south at once to lend a hand.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have just received word that Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth has discovered what may be the cause of the tumors that plague the timberlings. Please speak with him, and tell him I sent you.
Make haste, friend; he needs our help.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, so Rellian sent you to aid me. I am glad you arrived here so soon.
I have discovered something quite disturbing!
